DBAASP I529T IC90 concentration 7.732 µM conflicts with XML Table 4 HR2P-M2-alone value 7.752 µM; final curation preserves the conflict.
OA package/local packet inventory contains no supplementary assets or supplementary tables; no supplement-derived values were recoverable or required.
